$comment: Required scenario manifest. Listed tests must execute and pass; empty pending arrays remain unresolved delivery work. E03 and the Kafka portion of E09 were verified locally on 2026-10-14. Final same-SHA remote CI/CD and all remaining scenarios are still required.

scenarios.summary: normal path: two Anvil chains emit ERC20 logs; one verified Swap fixture
scenarios.note: Real native monolithic and four-service entry points, independent chain IDs 31337/31338, ERC20 max-uint and actual Swap log, full raw RPC/SQL digest and per-height header/parent comparison. Local dirty-tree evidence is not final same-SHA remote CI.

scenarios.summary: zero-log block / 100x duplicate / out-of-order arrival
scenarios.note: Real PostgreSQL: zero-log/duplicate blocks plus rejection of checkpoint gaps and unscheduled branch replacement; canonical late redelivery does not rewind. Full 100x duplicate fixture remains part of final acceptance.

scenarios.summary: fork depth 1/2/12; same-height new hash; tx re-included
scenarios.note: Real monolithic process + Anvil + PostgreSQL, depths 1/2/12, same-height branch replacement, same transaction re-included, canonical SQL/RPC digests equal; depth 2 also occurs while the process is stopped. Locally executed 2026-10-14; remote same-SHA CI still required. Native puller/Kafka/PG processor complete-block transmission, consumer restart and empty-header commit are additionally mandatory; this does not prove the pending two-chain full four-service mode parity in E13.

scenarios.summary: dual-chain fault isolation: A same-height rollback leaves B unchanged
scenarios.note: Real four-service deployment on two isolated Anvil chains equalized to one shared height; chain A evm_snapshot/evm_revert same-height replacement while chain B must stay bit-identical (checkpoint, blocks digest, events digest, reorg jobs, gateway page) and chain A must equal its own RPC oracle. Local dirty-tree evidence is not final same-SHA remote CI.

scenarios.summary: two-chain isolation: A rollback leaves B unchanged
commit-crash kill at boundaries + SIGTERM graceful shutdown
scenarios.note: Commit-window crash/SIGTERM cases plus actual Kafka same-group failure redelivery and a two-member broker rebalance against PostgreSQL: cancellation rolls back the old writer, rejects its token and preserves the unacknowledged offset; the next generation commits one effect. Native entry wiring is separately exercised by the required evm-e2e pipeline.

scenarios.summary: repair-job crash: DB rollback done, notify fails, restart resumes
scenarios.note: Actual native puller/processor: an unprovisioned isolated reorg topic causes a recorded publication failure after atomic rollback. The processor is held down with old-branch backlog queued. SIGKILL the puller, restore the topic, restart both processes, verify terminal orphan audit, canonical replay, persistent job completion and actual owed Kafka notices. Reuses the evm-e2e fixture; no synthetic resume substitute.

scenarios.summary: finality failure: finalized/safe unavailable, stale, wrong chain
RPC/WS failure: 429 Retry-After, timeout, 5xx, disconnect
scenarios.note: client-side 429 + Retry-After (pkg/infrastructure/rpc/failover_client.go), server-side 429 with Retry-After (pkg/plugins/api/rate_limiter.go), and 5xx/disconnect failover

scenarios.summary: DB/MQ/Redis failure: backpressure, redelivery, no early ack
scenarios.note: PostgreSQL/Redis outages and recovery plus Kafka same-group handler-failure redelivery, with explicitly isolated fault containers. All executed locally; no required skip. Production Kafka writer is also verified against a real three-partition topic: two chain keys, 24 records, one partition per chain and preserved publication order.

scenarios.summary: auth: nonce concurrency/expiry/address swap, bad origin/format
scenarios.note: the Redis-backed nonce tests (TestRedisNonceStoreTwoInstancesOneWinner) skip in -short mode and are not listed here

scenarios.summary: precision/decoding: signed/unsigned bounds, bad topics, unknown ABI
API compat + paging across cold/hot cache and reorg
scenarios.pending: needs the frontend build + a running API

scenarios.summary: mode equivalence: monolithic vs four-service canonical digest equal
scenarios.note: Real native monolithic and four-service entry points, independent chain IDs 31337/31338, ERC20 max-uint and actual Swap log, full raw RPC/SQL digest and per-height header/parent comparison. Local dirty-tree evidence is not final same-SHA remote CI.

scenarios.summary: performance / 30min soak
deploy/rollback: bad image/config, prior digest restore
durable finality evidence and projection
additive finality observation upgrade/down preserves raw identity
real mono/native APIs show safe, finalized, degraded, expiry and recovery
scenarios.note: Runs after each fixture completes canonical reorg. Real Anvil header proofs; controlled tags/errors/chain mismatch and aged proof timestamps. Both actual entry points own and stop their observers; safe never masquerades as finalized.

scenarios.summary: native manual intake uses shared explicit policy rather than silently retaining legacy confirmation cap
canonical aggregate count cache: real PG/Redis hit, legacy writes and dependency failure
mutation revision atomicity, legacy writes, truncate and schema epoch rollback safety
canonical aggregate Redis cancellation and bounded configuration
actual monolithic and native page/stats use Redis and match PG canonical counts
